s1.desc: a home gym drawn on a plain pale grey background

s2.desc: a room drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.notes: Pax skipping rope on an exercise mat; slow continuous zoom in (the mat grows ~1 px/frame on each side)

spans.view: with a red punching bag hanging from a ceiling hook

beats.text: Pax throws a quick series of punches at the hanging punching bag, bouncing on his feet with a fierce frown
Pax lunges with one huge punch that knocks the bag off its hook and out of view
Pax stumbles forward after the punch with his eyes squeezed shut and his flippers flung out

spans.notes: The ceiling hook stays exactly in place for the whole shot (camera locked). The big pose change at 47 (d1 spike) is the punch, not a cut.

beats.text: Pax grips a heavy barbell across his chest and glares ahead with a fierce frown as sweat drops appear
Pax squeezes his eyes shut and trembles under the weight, bobbing up and down as he strains
Pax keeps straining with his eyes squeezed shut while his cheeks flush red

spans.notes: Plain background, no fixed reference in view: the whole figure bobs 30-50 px as he trembles (storyboard: he shakes under the weight). Read as character motion, not camera shake. The jump at 61 is a pose change (he sinks and squints), same framing.
fast zoom out from the close-up to a wide view of Pax on the mat
Pax holding the barbell overhead on the mat (15 frames)
whip pan right from Pax to Polly; 118 is the first settled frame

spans.view: with a leafy potted plant on a little wooden stool

beats.text: Polly dances on the spot, tipping a watering can over the potted plant while holding a phone up in her other flipper
Polly turns away and sways her hips, waving the watering can and the phone
Polly spins round, swinging the watering can up over her head
Polly keeps dancing, watering the plant again with her eyes closed and the phone held out to the side

in_world_text: music player app on the phone screen
spans.notes: Camera locked 118-178 (measured: zero shift). Dropped because the phone carries a small figure of Pax (a little navy-and-white penguin charm clinging to its top edge, ~40 px at full res), a lead copy (D4), visible the whole span. The phone body is pale grey with a camera module like the iFin, but it has this charm instead of the iFin's little tuft: is_ifin unsure. Fields are filled in so the lead can flip keep if the charm is judged acceptable.
